mapper.select:
WITH em AS ( SELECT /*LGVPAY00010.retrievePaymentMasterData*/ em0.employee_number , em0.full_name_local , em0.date_hire_subsidiary , em0.date_retire , em0.probation_start_date , em0.probation_end_date , em0.apply_start_ins_yyyymm , em0.calculate_yn , em0.bank_name , em0.account_number /* 유효일자가 퇴직일 이후인 경우 퇴직일로, 이전인 경우 유효일자로 조회 */ , LEAST(NVL(em0.date_retire, TO_DATE('47121231', 'YYYYMMDD')), TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{effectiveDate}, '/', ''), 'DDMMYYYY')) AS search_date , TO_CHAR(LEAST(NVL(em0.date_retire, TO_DATE('47121231', 'YYYYMMDD')), TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{effectiveDate}, '/', ''), 'DDMMYYYY')), 'YYYYMMDD') AS search_yyyymmdd FROM emp_master em0 WHERE em0.employee_number = #{employeeNo} ) SELECT em.employee_number AS employee_no , em.full_name_local AS employee_name , cccm.common_code_name AS emp_category_name , ea.grade AS grade_code , cccm1.common_code_name AS job_title_name , TO_CHAR(em.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS hire_date , TO_CHAR(em.date_retire , 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS resignation_date , ea.organization_id , om.org_name_local AS organization_name , TO_CHAR(em.probation_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS probation_start_date , TO_CHAR(em.probation_end_date , 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS probation_end_date , TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN em.search_date BETWEEN em.probation_start_date AND em.probation_end_date THEN lgvpay_info_pkg.get_base_pay(em.employee_number, em.search_yyyymmdd, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, 'A') ELSE NULL END, 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS probation_base_salary , TO_CHAR(lgvpay_info_pkg.get_base_pay(em.employee_number, em.search_yyyymmdd, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, 'B'), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS base_salary , TO_CHAR(lgvpay_info_pkg.get_position_allowance(em.employee_number, em.search_yyyymmdd) , 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS position_allowance , TO_CHAR(lgvpay_info_pkg.get_job_allowance(em.employee_number, em.search_yyyymmdd) , 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS job_allowance , TO_CHAR(lgvpay_info_pkg.get_qualification_allowance(em.employee_number, em.search_yyyymmdd, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS qualification_allowance , TO_CHAR(NVL(lgvpay_common_pkg.get_planned_item_value(em.employee_number, em.search_date, 'ADJ_ALLOWANCE1', 'BASE_AMOUNT', #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS adjustment1_allowance , TO_CHAR(NVL(lgvpay_common_pkg.get_planned_item_value(em.employee_number, em.search_date, 'ADJ_ALLOWANCE2', 'BASE_AMOUNT', #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS adjustment2_allowance , TO_CHAR(NVL(lgvpay_common_pkg.get_planned_item_value(em.employee_number, em.search_date, 'ADJ_ALLOWANCE3', 'BASE_AMOUNT', #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS adjustment3_allowance , ea.job_family , ea.job_group , ea.attribute10 AS shift_type , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(em.apply_start_ins_yyyymm, 'YYYYMM'), 'MM/YYYY') AS ins_start_month , NVL(em.calculate_yn, 'N') AS pit_manual_flag ,( SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('IF_CONTRACT_TYPE', ecn.contract_type_code, null, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM tb_pay_emp_contract_n ecn WHERE ecn.employee_no = em.employee_number AND em.search_date BETWEEN ecn.contract_period_start_date AND ecn.contract_period_end_date ) AS contract_type ,( SELECT aa.competency_grade_point_code FROM tb_pay_emp_grade_point_n aa WHERE aa.employee_no = em.employee_number AND em.search_yyyymmdd BETWEEN aa.start_yyyymmdd AND NVL(aa.end_yyyymmdd,'47121231')) AS band ,( SELECT count(*) FROM tb_pay_emp_family_n pef WHERE pef.employee_no = em.employee_number
AND ( pef.relation_start_date is NULL OR pef.relation_start_date <= em.search_date )
AND pef.dependent_flag = 'Y') AS dependant_count ,( SELECT MAX(ccc1.common_code_desc) FROM lgcom_common_code_c ccc1 ,tb_pay_emp_certification_acq_n pca WHERE ccc1.code_type_code = 'LGVPAY_QUALIFICATION_TYPE_CODE' AND (NVL(ccc1.code_data1_value, ccc1.common_code), nvl(ccc1.code_data2_value,'x') ) IN ( SELECT nvl(ccc.code_data1_value, ccc.common_code), MAX(nvl(ccc.code_data2_value,'x')) FROM tb_pay_emp_certification_acq_n a , lgcom_common_code_c ccc WHERE a.employee_no = em.employee_number AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGVPAY_QUALIFICATION_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = TO_CHAR(a.qualification_type_id)
AND a.qlfc_acquisition_yyyymmdd <= em.search_yyyymmdd
GROUP BY nvl(ccc.code_data1_value, ccc.common_code) ) AND pca.employee_no = em.employee_number
AND pca.qlfc_acquisition_yyyymmdd <= em.search_yyyymmdd
AND pca.qualification_type_id = to_number( ccc1.common_code )) AS qualification , em.bank_name , em.account_number , DECODE(em.date_retire, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS retire_flag /* 퇴직여부. Y-퇴직 */
FROM emp_assig ea , em , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm1 , org_master om
/* 유효일자가 퇴직일 이후인 경우 퇴직일로, 이전인 경우 유효일자로 조회 */ WHERE em.search_yyyymmdd BETWEEN to_char(ea.assignment_start_date,'yyyymmdd') AND ea.attribute1 AND em.employee_number = ea.employee_number AND cccm.code_type_code = 'IF_EMP_CAT' AND cccm.common_code = ea.assignment_category AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND cccm1.code_type_code = 'IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE' AND cccm1.common_code = ea.grade_title AND cccm1.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND om.organization_id(+) = ea.organization_id
